title: Capstone core: a memory inspector
description:
Build the core of a memory inspector for your own program: regions, a hex view, typed reads and a search.

```
regions: 12 (3 executable)
view 0x... 256 bytes
read as int32 at +0x10: 100
search for int32 100 -> 2 places
```
hints: Find the region first, then check that the whole value fits inside it before `std::memcpy` (lesson 18.01).
Reuse the hex view, value search and region code from milestones 6 and 12.
requirements: A model of regions (from `VirtualQuery` on Windows, or a list here) with protection flags.
Hex view pages, typed reads (int, float, string) and a value search inside readable regions.
Everything works on memory your program owns or a practice target from this course.
stretch: Put it behind a Dear ImGui interface (milestone 14).
